text: <s>[INST] What is 2+2? [/INST] 2+2 equals 4.</s>
<s>[INST] Explain gravity briefly. [/INST] Gravity is the force that attracts objects with mass toward each other.</s>
<s>[INST] What is the capital of France? [/INST] The capital of France is Paris.</s>
